questions.question: Starting from the blue ball hopper with the solved board configuration, describe the complete path of the first blue ball.
questions.answer: The first blue ball drops from (2, -1), rolls onto ramp_right at (3, 0), then ramp_right at (4, 1), then ramp_right at (5, 2), then ramp_left at (6, 3), then ramp_left at (5, 4), then ramp_left at (4, 5), then ramp_left at (3, 6), then ramp_right at (2, 7), then ramp_right at (3, 8), then ramp_right at (4, 9), then ramp_left at (5, 10), and is caught at the left exit.

questions.question: In what order do balls exit the machine?
questions.answer: 8 balls reach an exit in the order: blue exits left, blue exits left, blue exits left, blue exits left, blue exits left, blue exits left, blue exits left, blue exits left. 8 exit left, 0 exit right, 0 are intercepted.

questions.question: How many total components are on the board (fixed + placed)?
questions.answer: There are 11 components in total: 8 in the starting setup and 3 placed by the solution.
